{{Quote|Your grandfather killed my grand-uncle in a duel! His blood howls for yours!|An unidentified Wookiee to Chewbacca|<ref name="SW:C2" />}}
A '''male Wookiee''' was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a duel by [[Attichitcuk's father|the father]] of [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], who later emerged as a powerful [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]]. The death of that Wookiee caused a lasting enmity between [[Unidentified Wookiee clan|his clan]] and that of Attichitcuk. Later, the grand-nephew of the deceased Wookiee met [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], son of Attichitcuk, and mentioned the vendetta between their two families.<ref name="SW:C2" />
